base 5.15 Makefile lists clk-chk-{mt2701,mt2712,mt6797,mt8173,mt8183,mt8186,mt8192,mt8195}.o which the ported Makefile dropped while still building vendor clk-chk-mt6765/mt6768/mt6779/mt6795/mt6779.c -> undefined refs to mt2701/mt6795/mt8183/mt8186/mt8195_clk_dump, mtk_clk_dump, clk_dump_register and clkchk_init. the earlier glue-strip removed the ENTIRE 'obj-y += drm/ vga/ mediatek/' line from drivers/gpu/Makefile to drop one missing vendor dir, which silently disabled the whole DRM subsystem, the DRM core objects and the VGA arbiter -> 8 link errors (vga_client_register, vga_default_device, devm_drm_of_get_bridge, of_drm_find_panel(s), drm_panel_*_get_bus_flags, mtk_smi_larb_gen1_pm_runtime_*). Both Makefiles restored from v5.15.220 (only the nonexistent vendor drm/mediatek/mtk/tcon/ line stripped) and the 4.19-only CONFIG_VGA_ARB/TRUSTED_KEYS/EFI/EFI_ESRT/EFI_VARS off via scripts/config, exactly as the device's even_defconfig has them. drivers/gpu/vga/ now builds, so VGA_ARB is enabled as upstream's Kconfig defaults it.

the ported hunks rewrote the #include lines of 7 upstream-only board DTS (mt6755-evb.dts, mt6795-evb.dts, mt6797-evb.dts, mt6797-x20-dev.dts, mt2712e.dtsi, ...) to downstream-only paths, breaking 17 of 521 DTB builds. Reverted; make dtbs now exits 0 with 528 DTBs. The even board tree is a vendor-new file and is not affected (see the DTS milestone).

this sandbox has no OpenSSL, and CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYRING=y makes certs/Makefile run scripts/extract-cert with the (empty) key list. A stand-in implementing exactly that one case was compiled into the build object tree as the gitignored artifact kbuild would have produced; it exits non-zero for any non-empty key list so it can never silently mis-build a trust chain, and no file in the kernel source tree was patched.

the full `make modules` pass exposed the last cluster: drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-core.c called the vendor static helper __buffers_in_use() and re-exported v4l2_get_link_freq (5.15 owns that symbol in drivers/media/v4l2-core/v4l2-common.c, so the link stage hit `__kstrtab_v4l2_get_link_freq is already defined`), and net/bluetooth/hci_core.c passed a const char * into a non-const strscpy. Those three files were held at base (include/media/videobuf2-core.h and include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h had already been reverted in the previous sweep); targeted rebuild of drivers/media + net/bluetooth then reported 0 error lines.  38 files under drivers/media still carry ported content and compile.

decisions.file: drivers/media, fs/overlayfs, fs/fuse, drivers/usb/gadget, net/ipv6, drivers/md, drivers/misc, drivers/scsi/ufs, drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac
decisions.reason: the =m module set surfaced vendor edits to generic subsystems that do not survive 5.15 (overlayfs ovl_revert_creds cred plumbing, fuse setattr2 op extension, gadget U_ETHER_DBG macro, ufs-qcom UFSHCD_QUIRK_BROKEN_CRYPTO, stmmac IRQ_TYPE_LEGACY, the videobuf2 VIDEO_MAX_FRAME static assert, ...).  79 files across drivers/media, fs/overlayfs, fs/fuse, drivers/usb/gadget, net/ipv6, drivers/md, drivers/misc, drivers/scsi/ufs and drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac were reverted so `make modules` reached 0 errors apart from the residual media/bluetooth cluster; each is a vendor extra in a mainline subsystem, not part of the MediaTek enablement chain.

the port deleted the 3 ignore lines upstream uses for the locally built host tools (/dtc, /fdtoverlay); leaving them deleted made kbuild's rebuilt host binaries show up as tracked modifications of the ported tree. Restored to base so the tree stays source-only.

decisions.decision: transplant, dropping .race_free_access and the vendor eint .pm member
